item.title: Ares Funds $1.3 Billion Debt for Windshield Firm Cary Buyout
item.description: Ares is providing a financing package worth around 13 billion Swedish kronor ($1.3 billion) to support the buyout of Swedish windshield-repair company Cary Group AB, according to people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Leanna Reeves

item.title: De Beers-Backed Kelp Blue Halts $114 Million Expansion in Regulatory Row
item.description: De Beers-backed Kelp Blue halted N$2 billion ($114 million) of planned investment in Namibia and moved some operations abroad after a five-year regulatory dispute, dealing a blow to the nation’s efforts to attract investment in new industries.
item.dc:creator: Kaula Nhongo

item.title: Fortress Weighs Poundstretcher Sale as UK Retail Pain Spreads
item.description: Fortress Investment Group is considering a sale of beleaguered UK discount retailer Poundstretcher Ltd., according to people familiar with the matter, after its larger rival Poundland collapsed in the latest sign of distress on Britain’s high streets.
item.dc:creator: Constantine Courcoulas and Jamie Nimmo

item.title: German Court Backs Berlin Project Fürst Over UK Debt Rework
item.description: The developers behind one of Berlin’s biggest real estate projects won their appeal against a provisional ruling that would have required them to repay a creditor despite a debt restructuring in the UK.
item.dc:creator: Libby Cherry and Karin Matussek

item.title: Japan Tobacco Studies Deal for Imperial Brands
item.description: Japan Tobacco Inc. is studying a potential deal for British cigarette maker Imperial Brands Plc, according to people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Crystal Tse, Manuel Baigorri, Dong Cao, Vinicy Chan and Eyk Henning
